products.name: FixAi
products.heroTitle: Smarter Home Maintenance, Powered by AI
products.heroDescription: FixAi helps homeowners track appliances, stay ahead of maintenance, and troubleshoot problems using AI — all in one simple place.
heroPoints: Understand issues before they become expensive repairs
Keep appliance details, manuals, and history organized
Get AI guidance in plain English, anytime
problemParagraphs: Most homeowners don't ignore maintenance — they simply don't have a system.
Maintenance schedules get forgotten. Appliance manuals disappear. Problems are noticed only when something breaks.
By the time you act, the cost is already higher — and the stress is unavoidable.
FixAi was built to change that.
products.platformTitle: One intelligent platform for your entire home
products.platformDescription: FixAi brings appliance tracking, maintenance reminders, and AI-powered help together — so you always know what to do next.

capabilities.title: Add Your Home
capabilities.description: Create a digital profile of your home in seconds. Everything FixAi does is tailored to your space.

capabilities.title: Track Appliances Automatically
capabilities.description: Store appliance type, model, history, and maintenance needs in one place — no spreadsheets or notes.

capabilities.title: AI-Powered Guidance
capabilities.description: Ask questions, describe issues, or get step-by-step help without technical jargon.

capabilities.title: Prevent Problems Early
capabilities.description: Timely reminders help you act before minor issues turn into costly repairs.
